description: Desktop permissions for Econ Studio: PDF export straight to a file (the app's own print_to_pdf command, to an absolute .pdf path the save dialog returned) with the system print dialog as its fallback (on macOS window.print() is routed to the webview print command), native save/open dialogs, document storage under the app data directory, restart-after-update, opening exported files in their default app, and the AI provider key in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager) through the app's own secret_get / secret_set / secret_delete commands. Files picked in a save/open dialog are added to the fs scope by the dialog plugin at runtime, so fs grants stay on $APPDATA plus creating the one default export folder ($DOCUMENT/Econ Worksheets). Revealing a file (opener:default's reveal_item_in_dir) is unscoped in opener 2.5; open-path covers the folders a teacher normally saves to (app data, Documents, Downloads, Desktop) - anything else falls back to reveal. $HOME/** is deliberately not granted. The library folder (a cloud-synced folder the teacher picks for sync) is reached only through the app's own library_* commands: the folder picker runs in Rust, every path is relative to the chosen root and refused outside it, and the root lives in $APPDATA/library-location.json, which only Rust writes - plugin-fs is denied that file (any letter case) through the global fs scope, so page script cannot point the library elsewhere.
